members.name: Safdar Iqbal
members.title: Chief Executive Officer & Founder
members.shortBio: The founder steering Barakode's vision — turning a bold idea from Pakistan into a software partner trusted worldwide.
members.bio: Safdar founded Barakode on a single conviction: that world-class software shouldn't be bound by geography. As CEO he sets the company's direction, owns its most important client relationships, and protects the standard every engagement is held to. He works where strategy meets delivery — shaping the roadmap, building the team, and making sure ambitious ideas leave the building as reliable, scalable products.
members.quote: We don't ship features. We ship outcomes our clients can build a business on.

focus.title: Vision & Strategy
focus.description: Setting the long-term direction and the bets that get Barakode there.

focus.title: Client Partnerships
focus.description: Owning the relationships that turn first projects into lasting partnerships.

focus.title: Building the Team
focus.description: Hiring and growing the people who keep the standard non-negotiable.

members.name: Humayon Abdullah
members.title: Full-Stack Developer
members.shortBio: The engineering force who turns designs into fast, resilient, production-grade products.
members.bio: Humayon is the engine room. He architects and builds full-cycle web and mobile products end to end — clean React and Next.js on the front, robust Node.js services behind, and the database and deployment work that holds it all together. He sweats the architecture before the first feature ships, writes code meant to be read and maintained years from now, and ships reviewable increments every sprint.
members.quote: Clean architecture isn't a luxury — it's the difference between software that scales and software that stalls.

focus.title: Front-End Engineering
focus.description: Pixel-accurate, accessible, blazing-fast interfaces in React and Next.js.

focus.title: Back-End & APIs
focus.description: Resilient services, clean data models, and APIs built to scale.

focus.title: System Architecture
focus.description: Designing the system before the features — foundations that hold under load.

members.name: Burhan Tariq
members.title: Business Development Manager
members.shortBio: The bridge between client ambition and engineering execution — partnerships, growth, and clear communication.
members.bio: Burhan is where new partnerships begin. As Business Development Manager he listens first — understanding what a client is really trying to achieve — then translates it into a scope the engineering team can run with. He owns the relationship from first conversation through delivery, keeps communication honest and timelines clear, and is relentless about turning a single project into a long-term partnership.
members.quote: Great delivery starts with truly understanding the client — everything else is execution.

focus.title: Business Development
focus.description: Finding the right-fit clients and opening doors to new partnerships.

focus.title: Client Relations
focus.description: Being the dependable point of contact from kickoff to launch and beyond.

focus.title: Growth & Strategy
focus.description: Aligning what clients need with what Barakode does best.
